narrative: 一个人站在厨房里，桌子变成了一片风景；或者一只手变成了一栋建筑。
地理空间没有发生剪切，改变的是比例。
当相对尺寸就是这个镜头的情节时使用它。同一个名字有时也用来指代不等的故事时间线，比如《敦刻尔克》（Dunkirk）中陆、海、空三条时间线。
那是叙事性的“比例”，而不是光学尺寸。不要在同一个提示词里混用这两种工具。
how: 锁定房间的画面板。用超大号的家具、微缩模型、分体比例合成，或者一次剪辑重新把身体印在同一建筑内的新高度上，来改变人物的比例。
阴影和接触点必须与新的尺寸匹配：一个巨人在同一主光下投下更大的影子。强制透视可以作为把两种真实尺寸静态对齐的辅助手段。
提示词：a scale shift of the subject: the body suddenly giant or tiny against the same room。
when: 用在一个人在自己家的走廊里变成一个玩具、或者一个怪物出现在玩具屋里的那个瞬间。不要把它用作一次只是放大某个细节、却没有改变身体与房间比例关系的普通特写。
vs: 强制透视（Forced Perspective）在同一个焦平面上对齐两种真实尺寸，使它们看起来属于同一个比例；比例突变则是这种关系本身发生的变化。
放大倍率（Magnification）比特写更进一步，展现一厘米之内的一个世界，它不会让整个身体在房间里变得渺小。
examples_film: 《亲爱的，我把孩子缩小了》（Honey, I Shrunk the Kids）和《蚁人》（Ant-Man）把身体安置在错误尺寸的家具和草地之间；《敦刻尔克》（Dunkirk）和《盗梦空间》（Inception）作为时间比例上的近亲出现在这个目录中：不对等的时钟，而不是爱丽丝梦游仙境式的房间。
前一对例子用于光学尺寸，后一对例子留给叙事性的时间处理。
mistakes: 常见的错误近亲是特写和变焦。破绽是一张放大的脸配上一个正常大小的房间，或者只是镜头推近，家具比例却没有变化。
解决办法是同一个建筑空间、一个全新的身体与房间比例关系，以及匹配的接触点。

faq.q: 电影中的比例突变是什么？
faq.a: 比例突变让一具身体在同一个房间里变得巨大或渺小。相对尺寸作为一个光学事件发生变化。另一种叙事性含义则指不对等的故事时间线。

faq.q: 比例突变 vs 强制透视
faq.a: 强制透视是把两种真实尺寸静态对齐，使它们读起来像同一个比例；比例突变则是这种关系的变化：身体在一个我们已经熟悉的房间里变成了错误的尺寸。

faq.q: 什么时候应该使用比例突变？
faq.a: 当尺寸本身就是一个已知空间里的笑点或威胁时使用它。如果你只需要一个更近的镜头，就跳过它，也不要把它和交叉剪辑不对等的时间线混为一谈。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写比例突变的提示词？
faq.a: 写下 "Scale shift of [Subject], the body suddenly giant or tiny against the same room"。保持建筑结构不变，匹配阴影，并说明新的尺寸。

narrative: A person stands in a kitchen and the table is a landscape. Or a hand is a building.
The geography did not cut. The scale did.
Use it when relative size is the plot of the shot. The same name is sometimes used for unequal story-time strands, as in Dunkirk 's land, sea, and air clocks.
That is editorial scale, not optical size. Do not mix the two tools in one prompt.
how: Lock the room plate. Resize the figure with oversized furniture, miniatures, split-scale composites, or a cut that reprints the body at a new height in the same architecture.
Shadows and contact must match the new size: a giant throws a larger shadow from the same key. Forced perspective can help as a static alignment of two real sizes.
Prompt a scale shift of the subject: the body suddenly giant or tiny against the same room.
when: Use it for the beat when a person becomes a toy in their own hallway, or a monster in a dollhouse. Do not use it as a simple close-up that only magnifies a detail without changing the body-to-room ratio.
vs: Forced Perspective aligns two real sizes on one focal plane so they look like one scale. Scale shift is the change of that relationship.
Magnification goes closer than a close-up, a world inside a centimeter. It does not make the whole body tiny in the room.
examples_film: Honey, I Shrunk the Kids and Ant-Man stage bodies against furniture and grass at the wrong size. Dunkirk and Inception appear in the catalog as temporal-scale cousins: unequal clocks, not Alice rooms.
Use the first pair for optical size. Keep the second pair for editorial time.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousins are a Close-Up and a zoom. The tell is a big face with a normal room, or a lens punch with no furniture scale change.
The fix is the same architecture, a new body-to-room ratio, and contact that fits.

faq.q: What is scale shift in film?
faq.a: A scale shift makes a body giant or tiny against the same room. Relative size changes as an optical event. A separate editorial meaning uses unequal story-time strands.
Forced perspective is a static alignment of two real sizes so they read as one scale. Scale shift is the change: the body becomes the wrong size in a room we already know.

faq.q: When should I use scale shift?
faq.a: Use it when size is the joke or the threat inside a known space. Skip it when you only need a closer lens, and do not confuse it with intercutting unequal clocks.

faq.q: How do I prompt scale shift for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write Scale shift of [Subject], the body suddenly giant or tiny against the same room. Keep the architecture, match the shadows, and name the new size.
